title: Meet Kai: Smithtown Animal Shelter's Pet of the Week Available for Adoption by Local Residents - NewsBreak
text:
14 hours ago Kai, a three-year-old poodle and bully mix, has been named Smithtown Animal Shelter’s Pet of the Week. The shelter, located in Smithtown, NY, describes Kai as a playful dog with a friendly personality. When he first arrived, Kai had limited training and socialization. He has since improved and now enjoys playing with other dogs and interacting with staff.
Kai is available for adoption. The shelter recommends a home with older children. He may do best as the only dog or with another active, social dog.
Interested adopters can schedule a meeting with Kai. The shelter offers a Meet and Greet Room, dog runs, and a Dog Walk trail for these visits. Applications and more information are available on the Town of Smithtown Animal Shelter’s website.
The shelter also encourages community members to consider fostering. Fostering is suggested for those without other pets or young children. Foster parents provide temporary care for animals until they are adopted. Applications for fostering and adoption are available online.
